paper: Panickssery et al., Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition, ACL 2024, arXiv:2312.06681
layer_source: paper: best layer for Llama-2-7B-chat (of 32). LLaDA-8B is also a 32-block model, so kept by direct index. ADAPTATION: different model family; tune if needed.
coeff_source: ADAPTATION (flag for user). CAA's canonical protocol multiplies a PER-LAYER-NORMALIZED vector by a small integer multiplier (swept in {-2,-1,+1,+2}). Our harness injects alpha*raw_direction, so alpha is not the CAA multiplier. Default alpha=4 matches this repo's answer-position steering regime (E1 ran the analogous anchored direction at alpha 4/8). To mirror CAA's normalized-multiplier form, set normalize_direction=true and alpha=multiplier*avg_act_norm (avg_act_norm is stored in caa_direction.pt).
